tagline: From a song idea to something worth sharing.
intro: AI Music Maker brings songs, lyrics, audio and music visuals into one creative workspace. Explore our guides to write your first song, score a video or try a new sound.
start: Choose a scene, a mood and two instruments. Open the song generator and describe what you want to hear.
Listen to the draft: can you hear the words clearly, does the chorus stand out, and does the ending feel complete? Change one instruction before trying again.
When you have a passage worth keeping, use the music-video guide to plan shots and edit them to the beat.
prompt: A warm acoustic pop song for a quiet train ride home. Gentle guitar and soft piano, intimate vocals, a restrained verse and a brighter chorus. End softly.
prompt_note: Start with this description, then adjust the instruments, vocals and mood as you listen.
why: Explore a musical direction, learn from the examples and make it your own. Our guides bring together source references, prompts and step-by-step exercises for songwriting and music videos.
projects: Explore Suno’s official demos and creator examples, from folk and dance to jazz, piano and film scores. Choose a direction, try the prompts and follow the tutorials to develop your song or arrangement.

Turn a song into a release teaser, performance clip or visual loop. Explore official model demos and creator examples, then follow the nature-shot and portrait-singing tutorials from planning to editing.
